SMTO-WEB-0026 — SMTO couldn't confirm a detail the answer stated as fact

GUID: c0acf587-d480-5844-a0e4-423901a1a149
Slug: research-fact-not-verified
Domain: WEB · Subsystem: web_research

What happened

  • The answer stated a detail as certain, but SMTO's research never confirmed it. SMTO will only show it as unconfirmed, not as fact.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Wait for the run to finish. SMTO sends the answer back to the Model and asks it to confirm the detail or label it as unconfirmed. The check only allows details stated as fact when a page SMTO read actually shows them.
  2. If the run stops, ask SMTO to look for that specific detail on the official or original page, naming the item and the detail. A page that shows the detail lets SMTO confirm it instead of leaving it unknown.
  3. If an unconfirmed detail is fine for you, tell SMTO it may say which details it couldn't confirm. SMTO can then show the detail as unconfirmed instead of blocking the answer.

What success looks like

  • The answer shows the detail with a source link, or clearly says it could not be verified.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Remember that "couldn't confirm" doesn't mean "isn't true"; don't read a missing detail as a no.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Research proof rejected a non-UNCERTAIN claim that selects a fact whose state is UNKNOWN (not VERIFIED and not CONTRADICTED).

What this means

  • A non-uncertain claim selects a fact whose state is not VERIFIED and is not handled as the separate contradicted case. This is an opt-in research proof check. With enforcement disabled the runtime retains the answer; observation mode can record a fault without blocking it. Rejected proof does not erase completed source access or authorize another acquisition.

Why this can happen

  • A non-uncertain claim selects a fact whose state is not VERIFIED and is not handled as the separate contradicted case.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the fact state and available eligible evidence.

How to fix it

  • Raised as research_fact_not_verified in _verify_fact. Acquire evidence that verifies the field, omit it, or emit it as an UNCERTAIN claim (rendered as 'could not be verified') when the contract allows unverified results; do not convert missing evidence into a negative finding.
  • Obtain authorized evidence for the unknown field, omit it, or report permitted uncertainty.

Retry and execution caution

  • Use verified facts or an explicit scoped limitation.

How to verify the fix

  • The field is verified from supported evidence or rendered under an allowed uncertainty contract.

What not to do

  • Do not present an unknown fact as verified or turn missing evidence into a negative finding.

Technical notes

  • This is an opt-in research proof check. With enforcement disabled the runtime retains the answer; observation mode can record a fault without blocking it. Rejected proof does not erase completed source access or authorize another acquisition.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
